entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Things have been getting[n]busy again lately.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Come home and show Papa Sojiro[n]how willing you are to work.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Something happen to you? Don't[n]be afraid to come back, OK?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Looks like I wasn't wrong to[n]judge you. Come on back.[n]I'll be waiting for you.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What are you going to do? Will you[n]accept the chief's invitation?
